adaptation_contract: The predecessor is verified through its complete exact file identity, every pinned dependency, all 31 expected receipts, emitted manifests and current producing code hashes.
The new eight-file immutable source manifest binds Git blob IDs, SHA-256, byte counts, source heads and URLs. Source Python remains inert .py.txt data.
The experiment is regenerated before admission. Its nine-artifact manifest binds all five current experiment producers, the source manifest and predecessor identity.
Regenerated local and global receipts retain current producer, source and artifact bindings. Hash changes caused by portable paths and readable prose are explicit; mathematical checks are unchanged.
Absolute output and input roots are normalized in both keys and values before JSON is written. Independent helper code remains byte-identical and hash-guarded before import.
The emitted manifest excludes the separately generated projector-control receipt, avoiding stale receipt recursion on replay. The aggregate checks both independently.
